summary.text: Colt Shelby is a resident of Cecil in Franklin County and the Libertarian nominee for governor. He sued the state to move up the special election for the late Sen. Gary Stubblefield's seat, in the district where Gov. Sanders proposed a 3,000-bed prison. He calls the LEARNS Act a failure and wants to scale back the voucher program.

paragraphs.text: Resident of Cecil, Franklin County; sued the state to move up the date of the Senate District 26 special election after the death of Sen. Gary Stubblefield.
